items.title: Mettler-Toledo (NYSE:MTD) Reports Q2 CY2026 In Line With Expectations
items.summary: Precision measurement company Mettler-Toledo (NYSE:MTD) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 4.5% year on year to $1.03 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $11.46 per share was 6.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
